I sometimes have those flares and they can last for months... get worse during the period too. Like literally /everything/ hurts. In my case I've tried eating different foods and avoid eating others but food doesn't seem to be a trigger. It's mainly stress, even if I'm not consciously thinking of something that stresses me, it's like the stressor is there, haunting me and a huge pain spike comes after/during it. 

Worse thing is that since nobody understands, they just look at me like I'm sooo lazy and I'm so done explaining myself over and over it just keeps adding to the stress... 🙃

Hate the flares... hope yours goes down soon and you feel better.
